title: Bochner–Riesz multipliers in three dimensions
summary: We prove the three-dimensional Bochner–Riesz conjecture in its strict-order formulation. The main result is boundedness of the Bochner–Riesz multipliers on $`L^3(\mathbb R^3)`$ for every positive order. Interpolation and duality then give the full conjectured strict range.

review.reason: Proves boundedness of three-dimensional Bochner–Riesz multipliers in the strict-order range.
